result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a well-maintained sidewalk separated from the roadway by a grass buffer on the left, and a protected bike lane on the right. A signalized intersection with a marked zebra crosswalk is visible ahead, providing a designated crossing point, though the roadway pavement shows signs of wear.

hazards.name: Pavement degradation
hazards.description: Visible cracking and patching in the roadway surface can affect vehicle stability and cyclist safety.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and foreground of the roadway

hazards.name: Unprotected crossing distance
hazards.description: The marked crosswalk spans the entire roadway without a median refuge island, increasing exposure time for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island at the crosswalk to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Pavement Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair the cracked and patched roadway surface to ensure a smooth and predictable path for all road users.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles receive a green light.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment consists of a narrow sidewalk directly adjacent to a multi-lane roadway without a buffer or physical separation. There are no marked crosswalks or traffic calming measures visible, and a wide driveway entrance creates a potential conflict point for pedestrians in this residential area.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossing
hazards.description: No designated crossing point is visible for pedestrians to cross the multi-lane roadway in a residential context.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the center of the roadway

hazards.name: No sidewalk buffer
hazards.description: The sidewalk is located immediately next to the curb with no planting strip or physical barrier to protect pedestrians from moving traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the far side of the road

hazards.name: Driveway conflict point
hazards.description: A wide driveway entrance for a parking lot crosses the sidewalk, increasing the risk of vehicle-pedestrian collisions.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image where the black car is entering/exiting

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked mid-block crosswalk with high-visibility continental markings and pedestrian warning signs.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the curb to provide separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Narrow the travel lanes to reduce vehicle speeds and shorten the crossing distance for pedestrians.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment consists of a single paved sidewalk on the right side of a two-lane roadway, separated by a curb and a narrow grass buffer. The left side of the street lacks a sidewalk, and there are no visible crosswalks or traffic calming features to facilitate safe pedestrian movement across the road.

hazards.name: Missing sidewalk on the left side
hazards.description: Pedestrians on the left side of the road are forced to walk on the grass or in the travel lane, increasing the risk of vehicle-pedestrian conflict.

hazards.name: Absence of marked crossings
hazards.description: There are no designated crossing points, requiring pedestrians to cross the two-lane road without any infrastructure support or driver warnings.

interventions.title: New Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install a paved sidewalk on the left side of the road to provide a continuous and safe walking path for pedestrians on both sides.

interventions.title: Marked Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: Implement a high-visibility crosswalk with appropriate signage to provide a safe and legal crossing point.

interventions.title: Speed Management
interventions.description: Introduce traffic calming measures such as lane narrowing or speed humps to reduce vehicle speeds and improve safety for all road users.

result.summary: The image shows a well-maintained paved sidewalk separated from the roadway by a grass buffer and a concrete curb. A wooden fence and dense vegetation line the back of the walkway, providing a clear boundary but creating a blank frontage.

hazards.name: Lack of street lighting
hazards.description: No street light poles are visible, which may reduce pedestrian visibility and safety at night.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility and personal safety for pedestrians after dark.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Ensure trees and shrubs are trimmed to maintain the full clear width of the sidewalk and prevent encroachment.
